name: Peter Schutz
description: Frankfurt, 1983: a white concept called Gruppe B. He signed off the most advanced road car on earth knowing every one built would lose money. It became the 959.
creator: bnuuy

+4 handling off the tarmac in any 4WD Porsche — Paris-Dakar 1986: first, second and sixth
+4% top speed in any Porsche 959 — 197mph, the fastest road car of 1986
+5% to every stat in the Gruppe B programme cars: the Prototype, the Vorserie, the Paris-Dakar and the 961
